title.narrative: Programme for Country Partnership for the Kyrgyz Republic

description.narrative: Through the Programme for Country Partnership for the Kyrgyz Republic 2025-2029, UNIDO - together with the Cabinet of Minister of the Kyrgyz Republic and other national and international partners # will support the Government in fostering Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID). Resting on a multi-stakeholder partnership led by the Cabinet of Ministers of Kyrgyzstan and the key Ministries and Government insti tutions, the PCP sets a programmatic vision to accelerate the country#s sustainable industrial development and unlock the investment potential through the delivery of an integrated service package that combines UNIDO's advisory and normative services, technical cooperation and convening function, facilitating the mobilization of partners and resources to achieve greater development impact. Based on the strong ownership of the Government of Kyrgyzstan, the PCP will support the Government in fostering the modernization of the selected industrial sectors, including agro-industrial processing sector, textile (apparel and garments), construction materials, energy, pharmaceutical industry and tourism, through enhanced market access and integration into regional and global value chains.
